datasets.name: FOR-instance
datasets.geography: Norway · Austria · Czechia · New Zealand · Australia
datasets.labels: Tree instances; terrain, low vegetation, stem and branch classes
datasets.note: Original semantic classes do not provide a simple wood/foliage crosswalk. Preserve the official dev/test protocol.

datasets.provenance: Source of collections reused by FOR-instance V2; a new release is not an independent site.

datasets.name: FOR-instance V2

datasets.scanner: ALS, TLS and MLS systems; collection-specific
datasets.labels: Ground, wood, foliage and tree instances
datasets.note: Reference namespace: 1 ground, 2 wood, 3 foliage. Preserve official splits and separate development LOSO from final evaluation.
datasets.correction: Scene identities, physical sites and upstream lineage need reconciliation before claiming site-out generalization.
datasets.provenance: Includes FOR-instance descendants and additional acquisitions, including BlueCat and MLS.
datasets.title: FOR-instanceV2 dataset and pre-trained model in paper entitled "ForestFormer3D: A Unified Framework for End-to-End Segmentation of Forest LiDAR 3D Point Clouds"

datasets.name: ForestSemantic

datasets.title: ForestSemantic: A Dataset for Semantic Learning of Forest from Close-Range Sensing

datasets.name: ForestSemantic-MS

datasets.provenance: Potential relationships to other FGI collections require capture-level evidence; shared institutions do not prove overlap.
datasets.title: ForestSemantic-MS Dataset: multispectral LiDAR forest point clouds for fine-grained forest semantic segmentation

datasets.name: FGI-EMIT
datasets.labels: Tree instances; other, tree, building, vehicle, pole, out
datasets.note: External terminal evaluation in the existing study. Its broad tree class cannot supervise wood/foliage discrimination.
datasets.correction: Keep class 5 out-points masked and retain native semantic categories. Do not move reserved data into fitting.
datasets.provenance: 19 files with per-scanner radiometric channels; units and calibration remain channel-specific.
datasets.title: FGI-EMIT: a multispectral high-density airborne laser scanning benchmark dataset for individual tree segmentation
datasets.coordinate_policy: Original numeric XYZ preserved. Missing CRS is not inferred; unit and height-datum compatibility require source-level review.

datasets.name: EvoMS
datasets.labels: Plots 1–2: tree instances, foliage, wood, understory; 18 unlabeled plots
datasets.note: Only two plots are labeled. The existing study reserves them for external evaluation and excludes unlabeled plots from fitting.
datasets.correction: Coordinates are already ground-normalized. Do not run a second terrain normalization. Keep understory distinct.
datasets.provenance: Labeled and unlabeled subsets have different permitted roles in the frozen study protocol.
datasets.title: EvoMS: multispectral LiDAR forest point clouds with partial semantic annotations
datasets.coordinate_policy: Original numeric XYZ preserved. Missing CRS is not inferred; unit and height-datum compatibility require source-level review.

datasets.name: TreeScanPL10K

datasets.provenance: Conservative campaign/site grouping is needed; per-file instance IDs are not globally unique.
datasets.title: TreeScanPL10k: A Central European tree species dataset of annotated terrestrial laser scanning point clouds
datasets.coordinate_policy: Original numeric XYZ preserved. Missing CRS is not inferred; unit and height-datum compatibility require source-level review.

datasets.name: Four-site TLS benchmark

datasets.provenance: Provider documents boundary duplication. Site-level grouping must include all derived tree exports.
datasets.title: TLS forest instance segmentation benchmark: 2983 manually segmented trees from four plots
datasets.coordinate_policy: Original numeric XYZ preserved. Missing CRS is not inferred; unit and height-datum compatibility require source-level review.

datasets.name: LAUTx
datasets.labels: StemID; manual and automatic trees; plot treeIDv1 and updated treeIDv2
datasets.note: 515 manual/automatic tree pairs are annotation variants, not duplicate ground truth. Six full plots retain two label versions.
datasets.correction: All 1,036 files currently lack mapped canonical instance IDs despite preserving the source fields.
datasets.provenance: The local README documents updated labels and shared lineage with TreeLearn. Keep v1, v2 and predictions separate.
datasets.title: LAUTx - Individual Tree Point Clouds From Austrian Forest Inventory Plots
datasets.coordinate_policy: Original numeric XYZ preserved. Missing CRS is not inferred; unit and height-datum compatibility require source-level review.

datasets.name: Wytham Woods
datasets.labels: 876 isolated-tree clouds; tree identity in filenames; derived QSMs
datasets.note: A single-tree export supports tree-level studies, not full-scene detection scoring. QSM variants are derived reconstructions.
datasets.correction: PLY and TXT are alternative encodings. 280 harmonized trees exactly match the TLS benchmark; all 876 names and point counts match.
datasets.provenance: The collection contains 876 tree identities; 835 were included in the source analysis after boundary conditions.
datasets.title: Terrestrial laser scanning data Wytham Woods: individual trees and quantitative structure models (QSMs)
datasets.coordinate_policy: Original numeric XYZ preserved. Missing CRS is not inferred; unit and height-datum compatibility require source-level review.

mappings.name: Retain tree identity
mappings.rule: Retain positive treeID values; define coverage and unknown/background masks explicitly. Keep upstream dev/test provenance.
mappings.loss: Semantic classes differ. This does not supply a reliable foliage label or prove independent acquisitions.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Shared collection lineage
mappings.rule: Reconcile collection, plot and annotation descendants before splitting.
mappings.loss: No full point-set overlap audit has been completed. Dataset-out is not certified site-out.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Instance-schema crosswalk
mappings.rule: Map positive instance values; ground is semantic=0 in the source. Keep plot and boundary-tree groups together.
mappings.loss: Source tree semantics cannot be converted to wood/foliage ground truth.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Tree IDs + coverage policy
mappings.rule: Map positive treeID and retain completelyInside, species and source PointID attributes. Specify incomplete-tree scoring.
mappings.loss: The view adds no ground/wood/foliage annotations; locations are insufficient for strict site-out certification.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Instance IDs with out-mask
mappings.rule: Map tree_index, preserve native class meanings and mask class=5 out-points according to the protocol.
mappings.loss: Reserved external evaluation; tree versus other is not wood versus foliage.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Two labeled plots only
mappings.rule: On plots 1–2: foliage 0→3, wood 1→2; preserve understory as its own class. Retain tree_index and normalized-height provenance.
mappings.loss: 18 plots lack annotations. Do not terrain-normalize again or use reserved evaluation plots for model selection.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Collapse component granularity
mappings.rule: Ground 0→ground; trunk 2 and branches 3→wood; foliage 4→foliage. Retain low vegetation and woody debris separately.
mappings.loss: Collapsing subclasses loses detail. Whether fallen woody debris belongs to a target wood task requires an explicit task definition.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: No instance reference
mappings.rule: No tree-instance labels are documented. A semantic crosswalk cannot manufacture independent instance ground truth.
mappings.loss: Pseudo-labeling would be a separate model-generated training arm, not reference evaluation.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Derivative-rights review
mappings.rule: Keep source annotations intact; settle intended use and component terms before producing aligned derivatives.
mappings.loss: Three conversions remain intentionally deferred. Metadata availability does not grant derivative permission.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Versioned instance crosswalk
mappings.rule: For full plots, choose and record treeIDv2 or treeIDv1; preserve both. For manual tree exports retain StemID. Keep automatic outputs as predictions.
mappings.loss: The current coarse export misses these instance fields. Different label versions and automatic segmentations are not interchangeable references.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Shared Wytham tree exports
mappings.rule: 280 complete harmonized chunk sequences match exactly. All 876 Wytham tree names appear in the TLS collection with matching point counts.
mappings.loss: Group shared tree/capture identities across datasets before splitting. The remaining pairs require geometry-level confirmation.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

mappings.name: Channel calibration review
mappings.rule: Check wavelength, radiometric units, calibration and co-registration per capture before pooling spectral channels.
mappings.loss: Shared channel names or research institutions do not prove equal radiometry or independent sites.
mappings.implementation: Specification only; no transformation executed by this hub

findings.title: 398 duplicate normalized exports
findings.description: 118 within the TLS benchmark and 280 across Wytham/TLS share complete recorded chunk-hash sequences. No originals have been deleted.

findings.title: 118 exact copies span train / validation
findings.description: The source manifests identify byte-identical TLS tree exports in both folders. Official plot splits and extracted-tree evaluation have different units.

findings.title: 1,036 files need an instance crosswalk
findings.description: StemID and treeIDv1/v2 survive in original_points but are not read by the existing harmonizer. 515 manual/automatic pairs must remain separate annotation variants.

findings.title: Available source labels are not all mapped
findings.description: FOR v1 classification is unmapped in 32 files. Six ForestSemantic-MS files preserve low vegetation and woody debris without a coarse semantic assignment. This requires task-specific mapping decisions.

findings.title: No certified site-out split yet
findings.description: All normalized records still carry split=unassigned and physical_site=pending_review. Cross-dataset identities and annotation descendants must be grouped before evaluation.

findings.title: Three derivatives deliberately deferred
findings.description: ForestSemantic source files are acquired; their conversions await derivative-rights review. Other record-declared licenses still require component and intended-use checks.

findings.title: Point count is strongly imbalanced
findings.description: TreeScanPL10K accounts for approximately 85% of stored normalized points before deduplication. File counts do not measure independent sites or balanced training exposure.

audit_scope.metadata: All 96 asset manifests, 15,400 stored-file records, 5,626 normalized cloud records and 48,177 chunk records.
audit_scope.payload_samples: 40 chunks / 17,102,064 points across all 20 observed source field schemas.
audit_scope.limits: No full reread of all 22.15 billion points, order-invariant geometry audit, scanner calibration validation, or final license admission. Duplicate groups are evidence for review, not deletion instructions.
